create_bipedalwalker_default_env: create a BipedalWalkerDefault gym environment with default terrain configuration
create_bipedalwalker_insane_env: create a BipedalWalkerInsane gym environment with all terrain obstacles maxed out
create_bipedalwalker_xchal_env: create a procedurally generated BipedalWalkerXChal environment with random obstacle parameters
create_bipedalwalker_poet_rose_env: create a BipedalWalkerPOETRose gym environment using a specific rose ID like 1a or 2b
create_bipedalwalker_config: create an EnvConfig with custom stump height, pit gap, stair, and roughness parameters
